comment: Good Guy. Wish guidelines on some things on syllabus were more explicit
I took Professor Sutton for my FYS. He was great! Would definitely take him again.

Sutton is great. This class has the potential to be super boring, but he made it worthwhile. One of my favorite teachers. The class is almost all group projects and a lot of presentations. Definitely helpful for real world. Would definitely grab a beer with Sutton.

Such a nice and intelligent guy who really wants to see you do well. I had low expectations for the class but he made it an enjoyable and engaging course. Class presentations every week and occasional quizzes. Overall, an easy class if you put in a moderate amount of effort. Great person to take this bschool capstone with.
